pageTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Singapore
metaDescription: 7,097 practical places mapped in Singapore: 796 public toilets, 232 drinking water points, 1,788 places to park. Free on iOS and Android.
heroTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Singapore
heroLead: Voyager Maps has 7,097 practical places mapped in Singapore — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Singapore. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Singapore on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Singapore
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Singapore it currently holds 796 public toilets and 232 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Singapore has 3.4 times more public toilets than places to refill a bottle — 796 against 232. Worth filling up before you set out.
